blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型越来越多地部署在安全关键领域,但其易受后门攻击的可能性仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。 虽然现有的防御手段已经从以视觉为中心的补丁提示发展到无监督的内部关注统计,但它们在根本上受到依赖静态快照和攻击特异性heuristic的制约. 鉴于双重模式之间错综复杂的相互作用,多式联运触发器的广阔设计空间允许各种威胁,例如文字注入、次概念噪声以及协调的跨模式触发器,从而容易规避这种僵硬的前兆,特别是在实际世界应用中未知攻击类型时。 在本文中,我们通过将诊断范式从静态观测转向动态输出演化,重新思考后门检测. 我们观察到,成功的攻击不可避免地会劫持模型的解码轨迹,在一代人的时间里窃取内部模式的贡献,同时尽管输入扰动却保持异常的输出变化. 为了抓住这一行为,我们提出EVO-Detect(EVO-Detect),一个统一的检测框架,通过两个互补的渠道来监测早期解码步骤中内部信号的动态演化:注意力流和逻辑流. 注意力分支衡量图像文本注意力分配如何在早期生成过程中演变,而对数分支则通过干预冲洗将输出分布对模式扰动的敏感性量化. 然后将这些轨迹转换成紧凑的样本级度量衡,使其与负控制签名相适应,这样自然扰动就不会被误认为是后门证据. 广泛的评价表明,我们的做法大大超过各种攻击家庭的最新基线,如BYE和TCAP。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: The surge in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) has catalyzed their rapid adoption across high-stakes environments such as autonomous decision-making, document understanding ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) , and specialized medical assistance ( Li et al., 2023 ) . By integrating vision and language, these systems provide exceptional cognitive depth. However, this structural complexity uncovers a grave security blind spot regarding the vulnerability to multimodal backdoor injections ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Rong et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Unlike overt adversarial attacks ( Goodfellow et al., 2015 ) , a backdoored MLLM maintains deceptive utility on standard inputs and is only hijacked by hidden triggers secretly embedded within downstream fine-tuning datasets. These triggers force the model to generate malicious, attacker-prescribed content, which has ignited significant industry-wide alarm.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型的激增 (刘等,2023;刘等. 2024; Zhu等, 2024; Dai等, 2023; Bai等, 2025; Chen等, 2024) 催化了它们跨越自主决策,文件理解(Mathew等, 2021),以及专业医疗援助(Li等, 2023)等高吸收环境快速被采纳. 通过融合视觉和语言,这些系统提供了非凡的认知深度. 然而,这种结构复杂性揭示出一个严重的安全盲点,即难以进行多式后门注射(梁等,2025;荣等,2025;刘等,2026)。 与公开的对抗攻击(Goodfellow等,2015年)不同,后门的MLLM在标准输入上保持着欺骗性效用,只被秘密嵌入下游微调数据集的隐形扳机所劫持. 这些触发器迫使模型产生恶意的,攻击者规定的内容,这引发了全行业的重大警报.

blocks.en: Existing MLLM backdoor defenses have evolved through two primary stages. Earlier methods were largely visual-centric, focusing on the detection of static local evidence like image patches ( Chou et al., 2020 ) . More recent studies, such as BYE ( Rong et al., 2025 ) and TCAP ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , have begun to exploit internal attention statistics to identify suspicious samples. While these approaches have successfully shifted the defensive paradigm from handcrafted features toward internal profiling, they can still depend strongly on modality-specific or static signatures. However, MLLMs present a vastly expanded threat landscape where adversaries can orchestrate diverse triggers across dual channels. These threats utilize natural textual suffixes, sub-perceptual visual overlays, or complex dual-modal triggers that remain dormant unless activated together as shown in Figure 1 . More importantly, in real-world deployment scenarios, attack types are typically unknown, causing earlier methods that over-rely on specific modalities or static priors to suffer severe performance degradation when confronted with unpredictable risks.
blocks.zh: 现有的MLLM后门防御已经经历了两个初级阶段. 早期的方法主要是以视觉为中心,侧重于检测图像补丁等静态局部证据(Chou等,2020年). 最近的一些研究,如BYE(Rong等人,2025年)和TCAP(Liu等人,2026年),已开始利用内部关注统计数据来识别可疑样本。 虽然这些方法成功地将防御模式从手工制作的特征转向了内部剖析,但它们仍然在很大程度上依赖于特定模式或静态的签名。 然而,MLLMS呈现出一种大范围扩大的威胁环境,对手可以通过双重渠道协调各种触发因素。 如图1所示,这些威胁利用自然文字后缀、子概念视觉上盖或复杂的双重模式触发器,除非共同激活,否则这些触发器将处于休眠状态。 更重要的是,在现实世界的部署情况下,攻击类型通常不详,导致先前的方法过于依赖特定模式或静止的前身,在面临无法预测的风险时,性能严重退化。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we aim to propose a modality-agnostic backdoor detection paradigm. However, developing such a system requires overcoming two major challenges: (1) discovering universal discriminative features: unlike localized patch triggers that induce conspicuous, static attention abnormality, different attack families manifest highly varied internal behaviors. Identifying a "first-principle" signature that consistently exposes the backdoor effect across unknown trigger forms is essential. (2) handling natural data complexity: real-world multimodal data is inherently diverse in content and quality. Benign samples may naturally exhibit outlier characteristics that mimic backdoor signals, leading to over-interception of normal data and severely undermining the model’s utility.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们打算提出一种模式不可知的后门探测模式。 然而,发展这样一个系统需要克服两大挑战:(1) 发现普遍的歧视性特征:与引起明显而静态的注意力异常的局部补丁触发器不同,不同的攻击家族表现出高度不同的内部行为. 确定一个"第一原则"的签名,通过未知的触发形式持续地暴露出后门效应是至关重要的. (2) 处理自然数据的复杂性:现实世界多模式数据在内容和质量上具有内在的多样性。 Benign样本可能自然显示出模仿后门信号的外出特征,导致正常数据的被过度拦截并严重损害模型的效用.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce EVO-Detect, a dynamic, unified diagnostic framework that shifts the focus from static snapshots to decoding evolution .
To address the first challenge, we draw inspiration from two observations: firstly, poisoned samples induce a persistent, abnormal redirection in the image-text attention allocation across a continuous temporal horizon, rather than a single-token anomaly; secondly, the resulting output logits distribution exhibits an inherent rigidity and a distinctive contribution gap when one modality is ablated, signaling a loss of cross-modal semantic alignment. Based on these insights, we propose a dual-stream diagnostic paradigm, including Attention Flow and Logits Flow . Specifically, the former branch monitors the evolution of image-text attention allocation to identify persistent redirection toward trigger-related tokens, while the latter branch quantifies the sensitivity of the next-token distribution through interventional modality ablations to detect the loss of cross-modal coordination. By monitoring these dynamic trajectories over an early decoding window, our framework exposes the underlying hijacking mechanism regardless of the trigger’s specific form.
To resolve the second challenge, we implement a Control-Aware Reference Normalization mechanism. Recognizing that false alarms often stem from the accumulation of moderate deviations across multiple metrics rather than one dominant anomaly, we introduce Clean Reference Anchoring to measure departures from normal decoding behavior and Control Baseline Normalization to down-weight non-malicious fluctuations. By normalizing each metric against matched benign references and upper-quantile control baselines, our framework effectively suppresses false positives while preserving high sensitivity to genuine backdoor-induced anomalies. Our contributions are as follows:

为了应对第一个挑战,我们从两个观察中汲取了灵感:第一,中毒样品在图像文本的注意力分配中诱发持续、不正常地改变方向,跨越一个持续的时间范围,而不是一个单托异常;第二,结果的输出对数分布显示出一种模式减弱时的内在僵化性和独特的贡献差距,表明跨模式语义对齐的丧失。 基于这些见解,我们提出了一个双流诊断范式,包括注意力流动和逻辑流动。 具体而言,前分支监测图像文本注意力分配的演变情况,以识别持续转向与触发相关的信号,而后分支则通过干预方式来分解下接方式分配的敏感性,以发现跨模式协调的损失。 透过早期的解码窗口监控这些动态轨道, 我们的框架暴露了潜在的劫持机制,

blocks.en: • We present a dynamic, modality-agnostic backdoor detection framework that effectively intercepts a wide spectrum of threats, including various textual, visual, and coordinated dual-trigger attacks, without requiring prior knowledge of the specific attack signature. • We introduce a dual-flow diagnostic paradigm that transitions backdoor detection from static snapshots to dynamic trajectory analysis, jointly monitoring the evolution of image-text Attention Flow and Logits Flow over early decoding steps to unmask the hijacking mechanism. • We design a Control-Aware Reference Normalization mechanism that evaluates dynamic trajectories against matched benign references to suppress false alarms, ensuring that legitimate complexity is not misidentified as backdoor evidence. • We achieve strong performance across multiple attack families. Even on the most challenging dual-trigger attacks, our framework achieves the lowest average ASR (5.2%), compared with 81.3% for BYE and 71.8% for TCAP.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1. 多种大型语文模式

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved into Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by integrating vision encoders such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and modern visual instruction tuning pipelines ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2023 ) . To bridge the gap between general pre-training and task-specific deployment, the Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service (FTaaS) paradigm has become widely adopted ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) allow users to easily customize MLLMs. However, this structural separation of user-provided data and server-side training creates a significant security blind spot.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)通过集成CLIP(拉德福德等,2021年)等视觉编码器和现代视觉导调管(刘等,2023年;刘等,2024年;戴等,2023年)而演变为多模式大语言模型. 为了弥合一般的预训和任务具体部署之间的差距, " Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service " (FataaS)范式被广泛采用(Huang等,2025年)。 LoRA等参数高效技术(Hu等,2022年)可以方便用户自定义MLLM. 然而,这种从结构上分离用户提供的数据和服务器侧培训的做法造成了一个很大的安全盲点。

blocks.en: 2.2. MLLM Backdoor Attacks
blocks.zh: 2.2. MLLM后门攻击

blocks.en: The FTaaS paradigm exposes MLLMs to backdoor attacks, where adversaries inject a fraction of poisoned samples containing malicious triggers into the user-provided dataset ( Li et al., 2024 ) . During fine-tuning, the model learns a hidden association between the trigger and a predefined malicious output, while maintaining normal behavior on clean inputs. In the multimodal context, attackers can exploit different input channels ( Liang et al., 2025 ) . Text-based triggers manipulate prompts via specific keywords or syntactic transformations such as HiddenKiller ( Qi et al., 2021 ) . Visual triggers have evolved from localized patches such as BadNets ( Gu et al., 2019 ) to blend-based overlays ( Chen et al., 2017 ) and warping-based perturbations such as WaNet ( Nguyen and Tran, 2021 ) . Moreover, the recent trend points toward dual-trigger attacks, which require coordinated activation across both image and text modalities. This dual-key mechanism is highly challenging: single-modality detectors fail because the backdoor remains dormant unless both triggers appear together. Figure 2 provides concrete examples of poisoned samples across these diverse attack families.
blocks.zh: FTaaS范式让MLLMs暴露在后门攻击中,对手在用户提供的数据集中注入了一小部分含有恶意触发的被毒样本(Li等,2024年). 在微调期间,该模型会学习出触发器和被预定义的恶意输出之间的隐藏关联,同时在清洁输入上保持正常行为. 在多式联运背景下,攻击者可以利用不同的输入渠道(梁等,2025.). 基于文字的触发器通过特定关键词或同步转换来操纵提示,如HideKiller(Qi等,2021年). 视觉触发器已经从BadNets等本地化补丁(Gu等,2019年)演化为以混合为主的叠加(Chen等,2017年)和以WaNet(Nguyen和Tran等,2021年)为主的waping扰动. 此外,最近的趋势是双重触发攻击,这需要通过图像和文字模式协调激活。 这种双键机制极具挑战性:单式探测器出故障,因为后门仍然处于休眠状态,除非两个触发器同时出现. 图2提供了这些不同攻击家庭中毒样本的具体实例。

blocks.en: 2.3. MLLM Backdoor Defenses
blocks.zh: 2.3. MLLM 后门防御

blocks.en:
Existing backdoor defenses generally fall into three categories: input pre-processing, backdoor elimination, and poisoned-sample detection/filtering ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Input pre-processing disrupts trigger patterns but often relies on strong clean references and may degrade benign semantics. Backdoor elimination focuses on pruning or repairing model parameters ( Liu et al., 2018 ) , usually with access to trusted clean anchors. In contrast, poisoned-sample filtering audits a downstream fine-tuning dataset and removes high-risk samples before purification or re-fine-tuning ( Tran et al., 2018 ) . Representative defenses span different intervention stages: SentiNet ( Chou et al., 2020 ) detects localized universal attacks at inference time, ZIP ( Shi et al., 2023 ) purifies input images for black-box backdoor defense, and recent MLLM methods audit poisoned fine-tuning samples. Among the latter, BYE ( Rong et al., 2025 ) utilizes layer-wise attention entropy to detect attention collapse toward non-semantic regions, while TCAP ( Liu et al., 2026 ) profiles the allocation imbalance across system, vision, and user-text components. These attention-driven filtering methods still leave output-side decoding dynamics underexplored.
To bridge the gap, our work moves beyond static, attention-only proxies. By dynamically monitoring the early decoding trajectory through Attention Flow and Logits Flow and normalizing these signals against matched control references, we target the point where the backdoor ultimately manifests: the first few output decisions.
blocks.zh:
现有的后门防御一般分为三类:输入预处理,后门消除,和中毒-样本检测/过滤(Li等,2024. 输入前处理会打乱触发模式,但往往依赖于强烈的清洁参考,并可能降解良性语义. 后门淘汰主要以打出或修复模型参数(刘等,2018年)为主,通常可访问可信赖的清洁锚. 与此相反,毒物样本过滤审计下游微调数据集,并在净化或再精调前清除高风险样本(Tran等,2018年)。 代表性的防御跨越了不同的干预阶段: SentiNet(Chou等,2020年)在推断时间检测出局部普遍攻击,ZIP(Shi等,2023年)为黑盒后门防御净化输入图像,而最近的MLLM方法审核被毒害的微调样本. 在后者中,BYE(Rong等人,2025年)利用分层的注意力 en来检测注意力向非语义区域倒塌,而TCAP(Liu等人,2026年)则描述了系统、视觉和用户文本组件之间的分配不平衡。 这些受关注驱动的过滤方法仍然使输出侧解码动态得不到充分挖掘.
为了弥合差距,我们的工作超越了静态的、只注意的代理人。 通过动态监测通过注意力流和逻辑流的早期解码轨迹,使这些信号与相匹配的控制参考物相匹配,我们针对的是后门最终显示的点:第一批产出决定.

3.2. From Static Snapshots to Decoding Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.2. 从静态快照到解码进化

blocks.en:
Existing MLLM backdoor defenses primarily rely on static snapshots of internal model states, such as spatial attention heatmaps or single-token activation patterns. For instance, visual-centric attacks like BadNets often leave conspicuous traces where attention scores highly concentrate on a localized, connected patch area. However, such static heuristics are fundamentally constrained by their reliance on attack-specific priors; they become ineffective when triggers are distributed across modalities or remain sub-perceptual.
We rethink backdoor diagnosis by shifting the paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. Our research is motivated by the need to investigate the multimodal hijacking mechanism through two distinct yet complementary channels:
blocks.zh:
现有的MLLM后门防御主要依赖于内部模型状态的静态快照,例如空间注意力热图或单托活化模式. 例如,像BadNets这样的以视觉为中心的攻击往往留下明显的痕迹,注意力的分数高度集中在一个局部的、相连的补丁区域上。 然而,这种静态heuristic由于依赖具体的攻击前科而受到了根本的制约;当触发物在模式上分布或者仍然处于分概念状态时,它们就变得无效了.
我们重新思考后门诊断,把模式从静态观测转向动态输出演化. 我们的研究的动机是需要通过两个不同但相辅相成的渠道调查多式劫持机制:

blocks.en: Intrinsic Evolutionary Attention Characteristics (Attention Flow): We focus on how cross-modal attention routing evolves during the generative process. Our motivation stems from the hypothesis that a successful backdoor must establish a persistent, specific pattern of contribution between visual and textual modalities to sustain a malicious output. We aim to uncover whether there exists a consistent law governing this internal attention redistribution across various attack families.
blocks.zh: 内向演化 注意特征( 注意流): 我们侧重于跨模式的注意路由在遗传过程中如何演变。 我们的动机来源于这样一种假设,即成功的后门必须在视觉和文字模式之间建立一种持续、具体的贡献模式,以维持恶意输出。 我们的目标是找出是否有一项一致的法律来规范这种内部注意力在各种受袭家庭的再分配。

blocks.en: Extrinsic Interventional Decoding Distributions (Logits Flow): We examine the sensitivity of the output distribution through modality intervention. By systematically ablating image or text inputs, we aim to quantify the contribution of each modality to the resulting logits. Our intent is to determine if poisoned samples exhibit detectable rigidity in their decoding trajectory, where the dependency on the hijacked modality differs significantly from benign semantic alignment.
blocks.zh: 外出性干预解码分发(Logits flow): 我们通过模式干预审查产出分配的敏感性。 我们通过系统整理图像或文字输入,旨在量化每种模式对由此产生的日志的贡献。 我们的用意是确定中毒样本在解码轨迹中是否显示出可察觉的刚性,其中对被劫持方式的依赖与良性语义相去甚远.

blocks.en: We conduct qualitative experiments to verify these dynamic signatures and our analysis reveals several recurring trajectory phenomena as illustrated in Figure 3 :

blocks.en: (1) Temporal Persistence: Poisoned samples rarely deviate from benign ones at only one isolated token; the separation in internal signals usually persists across the first few decoding steps.
blocks.zh: (1) 时间持久性: 毒性样品很少在一个孤立的标志上偏离良性样品;内部信号中的分离通常持续到最初的几个解码步骤。

blocks.en: Unlike static artifacts that can be easily masked or bypassed, these dynamic signatures reflect the model’s underlying hijacking state across multiple inference steps. Consequently, these insights provide the foundational rationale for our EVO-Detect framework.

blocks.en: 4. Method
blocks.zh: 4.四. 方法

blocks.en: 4.1. Overview

We propose EVO-Detect, a dynamic, unified diagnostic framework designed to intercept diverse multimodal backdoors by shifting the focus from static snapshots to decoding evolution. As illustrated in Figure 4 , the framework processes candidate samples through a dual-stream pipeline: Attention Flow and Logits Flow.
Specifically, we monitor the model’s internal signaling over an early decoding horizon ( K = 5 K=5 ) to expose the persistent hijacking mechanism that characterizes poisoned samples, regardless of whether the trigger is visual, textual, or coordinated across modalities. The resulting trajectories are then processed by a Control-Aware Reference Normalization mechanism to suppress false alarms arising from natural data complexity, where clean references provide the benign trajectory anchor, while control baselines suppress false alarms caused by natural variation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出EVO检测,这是一个动态的,统一的诊断框架,旨在通过将重点从静态快照转移到解码进化来拦截多种多式后门. 如图4所示,该框架通过双流管道处理候选样本:注意流程和逻辑流程。
具体来说,我们监测模型在早期解码地平线(K = 5 K = 5)上的内部信号,以揭露毒药样本特征的持续劫持机制,无论触发器是视觉的、文字的,还是各种模式的协调的。 由此产生的轨迹随后由控制-AwareReference Normalization机制处理,以压制由自然数据复杂性产生的虚假警报,其中清洁的参考物提供了良性的轨迹锚地,而控制基线则抑制由自然变异而引发的虚假警报.

blocks.en: Specifically, we first discuss how the temporal evolution of cross-modal routing is captured via Attention Flow (Section 4.2) and how output distribution sensitivity is quantified through modality intervention via Logits Flow (Section 4.3). We then show how these trajectories are instantiated as sample-level metrics and normalized by the clean, suspected, and control streams (Section 4.4), before being fused into a unified suspiciousness score for the final filtering decision (Section 4.5).
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们首先讨论了如何通过注意流动(第4.2节)记录跨模式路由的时间演变,以及如何通过通过Logits流程的方式干预量化产出分配敏感性(第4.3节)。 然后,我们显示这些轨迹是如何作为样本水平的衡量标准进行即时分析的,如何通过清洁、可疑和控制流(第4.4节)实现正常化,然后被整合成一个统一的可疑分数,用于最后过滤决定(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 5.1. Setups

Datasets and attacks: We conduct experiments across four benchmarks with different image-text coupling patterns: ScienceQA ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , Flickr30k ( Plummer et al., 2015 ) , and IconQA ( Lu et al., 2021 ) . For image-caption experiments, we adopt the released ReCap-COCO-30K dataset ( Li et al., 2025 ) , a recaptioned COCO2014 validation set ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . ScienceQA and IconQA emphasize multimodal question answering, while COCO and Flickr30k emphasize image-text description and grounding. We evaluate six representative backdoor attack families grouped into three trigger categories. Visual attacks include BadNet ( Gu et al., 2019 ) , Blended ( Chen et al., 2017 ) , and WaNet ( Nguyen and Tran, 2021 ) . Text attacks include explicit prefix injection (Text Prefix, whose trigger phrase is appended after the prompt) and HiddenKiller ( Qi et al., 2021 ) . Dual attacks use jointly optimized visual and textual triggers that must be activated together, while either trigger alone is constrained to preserve normal outputs and is used as a single-modality negative case in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 数据集和攻击: 我们用不同的图像文本组合模式进行了四个基准的实验:ScienceQA(Lu等,2022年),COCO(Lin等,2014年),Flickr30k(Plummer等,2015年)和IconQA(Lu等,2021年). 对于图像封装实验,我们采用已发布的ReCap-COCO-30K数据集(Li等,2025年),即被取回的COCO2014验证集(Lin等,2014年). 科学 QA和IconQA强调回答多式联运问题,而COCO和Flickr30k则强调图像文字描述和地平线. 我们评价六个有代表性的后门攻击家庭 分为三个触发类别。 视觉攻击包括BadNet(Gu等,2019年),Blend(Chen等,2017年)和WaNet(Nguyen和Tran,2021年). 文字攻击包括明显的前缀注射(Text Prefix,其触发语句被后被及时附加)和Hidden Killer(Qi等,2021. 双重攻击使用联合优化的视觉和文字触发器,必须一起激活,而只有触发器才能保持正常输出,在评价中被用作单一模式的负面案例。

blocks.en: Models and baselines: We adopt two representative MLLM backbones, Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and InternVL2.5 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , both adapted with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . We benchmark our method against Vanilla FT, SentiNet ( Chou et al., 2020 ) , ZIP ( Shi et al., 2023 ) , BYE ( Rong et al., 2025 ) , and TCAP ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . We align the attack setting, the downstream fine-tuning dataset to be filtered, and the purification protocol across methods so that the reported differences reflect filtering quality rather than evaluation mismatch.
blocks.zh: 模型和基线: 我们采用两个具有代表性的MLLM主干线:Qune3-VL(Bai等,2025年)和InternVL2.5(Chen等,2024年),两者都与LORA(Hu等,2022年)相适应. 我们以Vanilla FT、SentiNet(Chou等人,2020年)为基准, (Shi等,2023年),BYE(Rong等,2025年),TCAP(Liu等,2026年). 我们调整攻击设置、下游微调数据集以便过滤,以及各种方法的净化协议,以便所报告的差异反映过滤质量而不是评价不匹配。

blocks.en: Metrics: We employ two metric groups to assess performance from both the purification and detection perspectives. First, we report clean performance (CP) and attack success rate after filtering (ASR), where higher CP and lower ASR are better. Second, when synthetic poison labels are available for evaluation, we report poisoned-sample detection F1-score. This separation is important because CP/ASR measure the practical benefit of filtering after re-fine-tuning, whereas sample-level F1 measures how accurately a method identifies suspicious samples.
blocks.zh: 计量:我们使用两个度量组,从净化和检测两个角度评估业绩。 首先,我们报告清洁性能(CP),并在过滤后攻击成功率(ASR),在过滤后,较高CP和较低ASR更好。 第二,当合成毒药标签可供评估时,我们报告毒药样本检测F1-分数. 这种分离很重要,因为CP/ASR测量在重新精细调整后过滤的实际好处,而样品一级F1测量方法如何准确识别出可疑样品。

blocks.en: Purification protocol: We adopt the same purification-style protocol as BYE and TCAP. Each defense first scores samples in the downstream fine-tuning dataset under audit and removes those above its threshold or filtering budget. A purified model is then obtained by re-fine-tuning on the retained subset under the same training recipe. We measure CP on clean evaluation data and ASR on triggered evaluation data of the purified model. For F1, ground-truth poison labels are used only for evaluation in the simulated benchmark and are never used to fit the detector.
blocks.zh: 净化协议 : 我们采用与BYE和TCAP相同的净化式协议. 每个防御单位在审计的下游微调数据集中先得分,取出高于其门槛或过滤预算的样本. 然后,通过对同一培训食谱下保留子集进行再精细调整,获得一种纯度模型。 我们以清洁评价数据衡量CP,以纯化模型触发的评价数据衡量ASR。 对于F1,地真毒标签仅用于模拟基准中的评价,从未用于安装探测器.

blocks.en: Implementation details: We employ a short early-decoding horizon of K = 5 K{=}5 unless otherwise stated. We extract attention-side features including image ratio, entropy, and step-to-step map drift, together with logits-side features based on divergences between full, text-only, and image-only outputs. We construct clean references with robust step-wise statistics, summarize matched controls with upper quantiles, and threshold the final score with a high-quantile policy. All normalization and thresholding choices are fixed once per audit slot rather than tuned per attack instance.

Defense Effectiveness across Attack Families. Table 1 demonstrates performance across six attack modes on ScienceQA, where it could be seen that our method achieves the lowest ASR on all visual and dual-trigger settings, and the best ASR–CP trade-off on textual attacks, where SentiNet reaches lower ASR only at a substantial CP cost (55.6–70.0%). blocks.en: Delayed adaptive attacks. Because K = 5 K{=}5 is a default horizon rather than a hard architectural constraint, we further evaluate delayed-target attacks that postpone malicious behavior beyond the initial decoding steps. On Qwen3-VL/ScienceQA text attacks, extending the window keeps F1 at 85.7–90.9% and reduces ASR to 0–10%. The harder delayed dual-trigger setting also benefits from a longer horizon: increasing K K from 5 to 12 reduces ASR from 36.7% to 13.3% for a five-token delay and from 43.3% to 3.3% for a seven-token delay, while F1 rises from 61.5% to 74.2% and from 44.0% to 71.9%, respectively. These results motivate using a larger or sliding window in high-risk audits.

blocks.en: 5.4. Sample-Level Detection Performance
blocks.zh: 5.4. 样本级检测性能

blocks.en:
To evaluate the effectiveness of our framework in identifying poisoned samples, we conduct a sample-level analysis on the ScienceQA dataset, reporting F1-score.
Sample-level results show that our method achieves the best F1 on nearly all attack settings across both backbones. Firstly, the margin is particularly evident on textual attacks. For example, on Qwen3-VL, F1 reaches 87.3% on Text Prefix and 77.2% on HiddenKiller, strikingly higher than BYE (42.0%/35.9%) and TCAP (81.0%/4.2%). A consistent performance gain is observed on InternVL2.5, where our F1-scores (90.6% and 76.5%) remain substantially above both baselines.
Second, our method remains competitive on visual attacks as well, achieving the best F1 across all Qwen3-VL settings and all three InternVL2.5 visual settings. This result shows that adding logits-side trajectory evidence does not weaken performance on classic visual triggers.
Third, the weaknesses of BYE and TCAP are consistent with their design assumptions. BYE is most effective when poisoning induces a clear attention-collapse signature and is therefore much less reliable on text-triggered or distributed-trigger settings. TCAP is generally stronger than BYE because it profiles attention allocation more carefully, but it can still become unstable when the decisive abnormality primarily appears in output-side trajectory rigidity rather than in attention allocation itself. In contrast, our method remains more uniform across attack families because it jointly uses attention-side and logits-side evidence.

为了评估我们框架在识别中毒样本方面的有效性,我们对科学质量评估数据集进行样本级分析,报告F1-分数.
样本层面的结果显示,我们的方法在几乎所有攻击设置上都实现了两个骨干上最好的F1. 首先,在文字攻击方面,差值特别明显。 例如,在Qune3-VL上,F1在文本前缀上达到87.3%,在Hidden Killer上达到77.2%,明显高于BYE(42.0%/35.9%)和TCAP(81.0%/4.2%)。 在InternVL2.5上观察到了一贯的业绩收益,我们的F1分数(90.6%和76.5%)仍然大大高于这两个基线。
第二,我们的方法在视觉攻击方面也仍然具有竞争力,在所有Quen3-VL设置和所有三个InternVL2.5视觉设置中都实现了最好的F1. 这一结果表明,增加对数-侧轨迹证据不会削弱经典视觉触发器上的性能.
第三,BYE和TCAP的弱点与其设计假设是一致的. BYE在中毒诱发明显的注意-缩合签名时最为有效,因此在文本触发或分布式-触发设置上更不可靠. TCAP一般比BYE强,因为它更仔细地描述注意力分配,但当决定性的异常主要出现在输出侧轨迹刚性而不是注意力分配本身时,它仍然会变得不稳定. 相比之下,我们的方法在攻击家庭之间仍然更加统一,因为它共同使用注意方和记录方证据。

blocks.en: To further illustrate the discriminative power of our framework, Figure 5 visualizes the distribution of the unified suspiciousness score S ⁡ ( x ) S(x) on the COCO dataset using Qwen3-VL. As shown in Figures 5 (A) and (B), our method establishes a clear, wide margin between clean and poisoned samples under single-modality attacks. Critically, in the challenging dual-trigger scenario as Figure 5 (C), the framework selectively assigns high scores to true poisoned samples. Meanwhile, single-modality negative cases (Vis Only and Txt Only) yield score distributions nearly identical to clean data, confirming that our Control-Aware Reference Normalization effectively suppresses false alarms triggered by partial or benign multimodal variations.

blocks.en: 5.5. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.5. 读取研究

blocks.en: Effect of the Decoding Horizon: We evaluate the sensitivity of the early-decoding horizon K K on ScienceQA using Qwen3-VL, with results summarized in Table 4 . The analysis reveals that detection performance improves substantially as the horizon extends beyond a single step. At K = 1 K{=}1 , the detector is too myopic to capture persistent trajectory deviations, resulting in weak F1 scores and high ASR across all attack types (e.g., a mere 18.9% F1 and 89.4% ASR against text triggers). Increasing the horizon to K = 3 K{=}3 yields significant gains, confirming that short-range temporal accumulation is essential for robust diagnosis. The optimal trade-off is achieved at K = 5 K{=}5 , where the framework effectively suppresses ASR while maximizing F1-scores, peaking at an impressive 96.6% F1 for visual attacks. Extending the horizon to K = 7 K{=}7 provides only marginal improvements for dual-trigger cases (reaching 83.6% F1) and slightly lowers F1 elsewhere, though visual/text ASR dip to 1.0%/14.0%. This mild degradation suggests that pushing the horizon too far begins to accumulate benign generation noise, which subsequently dilutes the malicious trigger’s initial activation signal. Ultimately, this pattern indicates that the most discriminative evidence is concentrated in the first few decoding steps, making a short horizon both sufficient and computationally efficient.

blocks.en: Effect of each module: To systematically evaluate the individual contributions of our proposed components in defending against diverse multimodal backdoor attacks, we conducted a comprehensive ablation study on the representative Qwen3-VL backbone. Results are shown in Table 4 . The analysis across three representative attacks reveals three key insights: (1) relying on a static, single-step inspection severely cripples detection, as evidenced by the static Attention Flow (AF) variant failing almost completely, which proves that continuous early decoding trajectories capture far more robust backdoor evidence than isolated frozen snapshots; (2) neither AF nor Logits Flow (LF) alone is sufficient for comprehensive defense, whereas fusing these branches yields a substantial performance leap, confirming that attention patterns and logit distributions provide highly complementary traces of malicious behavior; and (3) converting this fused evidence into a reliable detector fundamentally relies on the Control-Aware Reference Normalization module. Without this normalization, the average F1 score plummets from 88.9% to 68.2%, and the model struggles most against the stealthy dual-trigger attack (dropping from 83.3% to a mere 54.6%). Overall, these results validate that our framework’s robust performance stems directly from the synergy of dynamic trajectory profiling, multi-level feature fusion, and reference-normalized scoring.
blocks.zh: 每个单元的效果: 为了系统地评价我们提议的各组成部分在防御多种多式后门攻击方面所作的个别贡献,我们对代表Qune3-VL的骨干进行了全面的消化研究。 结果见表4。 对三个具有代表性的攻击进行的分析揭示出三个关键见解:(1) 依靠静态的单步检查,严重地破坏人的检测,这表现在静态的注意力流变体(AF)变体几乎完全失败,这证明连续的早期解码轨迹捕捉到比孤立的被冻结快照更坚固的后门证据;(2) 单靠AF和Logits流量(LF)都不足以进行全面防御,而使这些分支脱钩则产生实质性的性能飞跃,确认注意模式和登录分布提供了高度互补的恶意行为的痕迹;(3) 将这种被接合的证据转换成一个可靠的探测器,从根本上依赖于控制-Aware参考规范化模块。 没有这种正常化,F1的平均得分从88.9%跌至68.2%,模型与隐形双起攻击(从83.3%跌入54.6%)的斗争最为激烈. 总体而言,这些结果证明,我们框架的强健性能直接源于动态轨迹剖面、多层次特征组合和参考常态评分的协同效应。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we rethink MLLM backdoor defense by shifting from static snapshots to decoding evolution. We introduce EVO-Detect, which exposes persistent hijacking mechanisms by jointly monitoring internal Attention Flow and interventional Logits Flow. To handle natural data complexity, a Control-Aware Reference Normalization mechanism anchors diagnostic signals against benign references, effectively suppressing false alarms. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our modality-agnostic approach substantially outperforms previous attention-based baselines across diverse multimodal threats. This transition to temporal trajectory analysis provides a robust foundation for securing multimodal foundation models.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们重新思考MLLM后门防御,从静态快照转向解码进化. 我们采用EVO探测,通过联合监测内部注意力流动和干预逻辑流动,暴露出持续的劫持机制。 为了处理自然数据的复杂性,一个Control-AwareReference Normalization机制将诊断信号与良性引用相配合,有效压制了假警报. 广泛的评价表明,我们的模式不可知性方法大大超过以往针对不同多式联运威胁的基于关注的基线。 这种向时间轨迹分析的过渡为获得多式联运基础模型奠定了坚实的基础。
